text: DSH User-Agent 是面向 Web 客户端的 DSH 插件，通过包装宿主的全局 fetch，为启用改写的出站请求设置自定义 User-Agent，并在 Web 设置中提供 UA 设置页。用户可以开关改写、编辑并保存请求头；配置通过 dsh-user-agent 设置命名空间提供给宿主读取。适合需要统一调整 DSH 全局 fetch 流量标识的用户。安装后使用默认 User-Agent 即可，也可在设置页改为自定义值；不需要额外 API Key。

DSH User-Agent is a Web-client plugin that wraps global fetch and sets a configurable User-Agent on outgoing requests when enabled. Its UA settings tab lets users toggle rewriting and save a header value. The host reads the dsh-user-agent settings namespace. No API key is required.
想给 DSH 发出的全局 fetch 请求统一设置自定义 User-Agent。
能不能在 Web 设置里修改 DSH 请求使用的 User-Agent？
How can I change the User-Agent header on DSH fetch requests?
DSH User-Agent 的「改写请求头」功能：启用后包装宿主全局 fetch，将非空配置写入请求的 user-agent 头，并保留其他请求选项。
DSH User-Agent 的「UA 设置页」功能：用户在 Web 设置中开关改写、编辑并保存 User-Agent；后续请求读取已更新的配置。

@dsh-plugin/dsh-user-agent README · @dsh-plugin/dsh-user-agent：A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/dsh) plugin that rewrites the `User-Agent` sent by every outgoing HTTP request (LLM API calls and other global-`fetch` traffic) to a value of your choice, configured live from a dedicated **UA 设置 (User-Agent)** tab in the Web settings.

@dsh-plugin/dsh-user-agent README · Features：- **Rewrite anything that uses global `fetch`** — including the DeepSeek / OpenAI-compatible adapter calls from `dsh-llm-deepseek`, web search, and tools that fetch over HTTP. The configured UA overrides the caller's own header (e.g. dsh-llm's attribution baseline).
- **Live settings page** — a `settings.section` tab in the Web GUI Settings panel: toggle rewriting on/off and edit the User-Agent string. Changes apply to the very next request, no restart.
- **Standard settings integration** — the value lives in the `dsh-user-agent` user-settings namespace, so it persists across sessions and is editable by any settings-aware surface.
- **Clean lifecycle** — wraps `globalThis.fetch` only while the plugin runs; the original fetch is captured once and restored on stop / update / removal. Read-only fallback whenever `fetch` is unavailable.

@dsh-plugin/dsh-user-agent README · Configuration：Plugin entry (`cordis.patch.yml` / profile override) — the values act as the composition `base` layer and are merged with the user-settings section:

| Field | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | `boolean` | `true` | Master switch; when off the wrapper is a pass-through. |
| `userAgent` | `string` | `DeepSeek-Harness/0.1 (+https://github.com/deepseek-ai/dsh)` | The User-Agent applied to every rewritten request. |

@dsh-plugin/dsh-user-agent README · How it works：- The host half wraps `globalThis.fetch`. On each call it reads the current config (resolved settings scope, or the composition entry when no settings service is mounted), and when enabled with a non-empty UA it builds a new `Headers` and forces `user-agent` before delegating to the original fetch.
- The browser half registers the `settings.section` tab and reads/writes the namespace through the connection's ApiProxy (`api.settings.describe` / `update`), the same seam the aux/mainline DSH plugins use.
